navigation_debug.help: Right-click Humans to add/focus; use air to cycle focus; click ground to command only the focus; sneak-click a Human to remove, sneak-use air/block to clear.
navigation_debug.tool_tip: Observe up to 8: click Humans to add/focus, air to cycle; ground sets only the focus destination, other tasks continue; sneak-click Human removes, sneak-use air/block clears.
navigation_debug.helmet_tip: Wear to see up to 8 Humans with stable numbers, colored paths and individual cards; focus shows detailed candidate evaluations.
navigation_debug.permission: Creative mode or operator permission is required.
navigation_debug.human_only: Select a living Human from this mod.
navigation_debug.selected: Selected: %s. Do not click a destination block for passive observation.
navigation_debug.select_first: Select a Human in this dimension within 128 blocks first.
navigation_debug.busy: Another player is testing this Human.
navigation_debug.unavailable: Retreating, using an item, AI paused, or otherwise unavailable for testing.
navigation_debug.destination: #%s %s destination: %s, %s, %s; other tasks continue, maximum 120 seconds.
navigation_debug.cleared: Cleared all observers and released your entity tests; autonomous AI resumes.
navigation_debug.timeout: #%s %s test timed out; autonomous AI resumes.
navigation_debug.hud_health: Health %s | Fall damage budget %s | Drop limit %s | Effective range %s
navigation_debug.hud_work: Last grant: %s | Ground navigation call %s ms (includes reuse) | Last veto: %s
navigation_debug.legend: Per-entity path colors; focus candidates: purple=trial/partial, green=scored/installed, red=rejected.
navigation_debug.hud_endpoint: Actual route endpoint: %s (partial paths may stop short)
navigation_debug.selected_multi: Observing/focusing #%s %s. Ground clicks command only this Human; other tasks continue.
navigation_debug.focused: Control focus: #%s %s. Other entity tasks remain active.
navigation_debug.removed: Removed observer: %s. Only your test for this entity was cancelled.
navigation_debug.limit: At most %s observers; sneak-click a member to remove it first.
navigation_debug.focus_title: Focus #%s %s — destination clicks affect only this member
navigation_debug.multi_help: Match colored paths/nameplates to cards; use air to cycle focus. Candidates shown for focus only.
navigation_debug.help.title: Navigation observation: colors and markers
navigation_debug.help.scroll: Scroll to browse; Esc or Done returns (tests keep running)
navigation_debug.help.entities: Each stable slot has its own color. Removing another member preserves existing slots. Same-color boxes mark the entity, requested point or actual endpoint; use position and the focused panel to distinguish them.
navigation_debug.help.entity: #%s: this entity's route, position box, requested point, actual endpoint, overhead number and overview card.
navigation_debug.help.next: Small white box: the next node of each route. Later nodes use the entity color.
navigation_debug.help.enemy: Red box: a legally known target position; never follows a hidden enemy after permission expires.
navigation_debug.help.pending: Small purple box: a focused candidate being tried, or a partial path result.
navigation_debug.help.accepted: Small green box: a focused candidate scored, returned a complete path or was accepted. Scored does not guarantee final selection.
navigation_debug.help.rejected: Small red box: a focused candidate was filtered, rejected or pruned. Check recent focused records for its reason.
navigation_debug.help.limits: These debug wireframes do not change blocks. A recent request may only be a trial; the active route and endpoint show execution. Only focused candidates are displayed; switch focus to inspect another entity.
navigation_debug.help.controls: Pointer: right-click a Human to add/focus, air to cycle, a block to set only the focused destination. Sneak-click a Human to remove it; sneak-click air/block to clear all. Rebind the legend key in Options > Controls > Key Binds.
navigation_debug.detail.title: Reconnaissance diagnostics
navigation_debug.detail.stale: Snapshot expired: wear the helmet and select an in-range Human.
navigation_debug.detail.readonly: Scroll to browse. Diagnostic focus and layers affect display only; they issue no target, movement or command changes.
navigation_debug.detail.geometry: View rings show server-authored geometry, not unobstructed visibility. LOS lines represent checks that actually occurred.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.dynamic: Pink point: permitted short-lived dynamic position.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.last: Orange point: frozen last known position; does not follow hidden entities.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.recogniti: Entity-color point: limited observation point during recognition.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.sound: Cyan ring: sound investigation area, not a live source position.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.direction: Cyan line: incoming direction; no hidden shooter identity or distance.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.beacon: Purple ring: approximate beacon report area.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.los: Green line: an actual LOS sample; see details for sample age.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.blocked: Red line/point: actually detected obstruction sample.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.vision_ne: Entity-color view rings: distance-dependent unfamiliar-target view; geometry does not imply clear LOS.
navigation_debug.detail.marker.vision_kn: Light-blue view rings: server-authored distance-dependent familiar-target view.
